verdict.rationale: Orb is a billing and revenue platform, so in-product AI-generated insights are a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack shows no AI-generated insights or suggestions. Revenue forecasting, threshold alerts and SQL-based metrics are conventional analytics features, not AI-generated insights, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
